sermon.title: Maturity - August 13, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: God wants to complete us to the stature of Christ. Add virtue and knowledge to your faith, grow in the fruit of the Spirit, provoke one another to good works and abide in Christ’s doctrine. Like Job, seek God in testing—it was Satan’s hand, not God’s—and come forth as gold.
